name: DefenderBench
intro: DefenderBench是一个实用开源工具包，用于评估语言智能体在攻防和网络安全知识任务中的表现。涵盖网络入侵、恶意内容检测、代码漏洞分析及安全知识评估，支持多种主流大型语言模型的公平严格测试。
build_method: 公开数据集整合, 固定随机种子抽样, 模块化交互环境
metric: 网络入侵胜率, 宏平均 F1, CodeBLEU, DefenderBench 无权重平均分
task_type: Agent任务, 分类, 代码生成, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 领域特定, 多轮, 过程导向
scale: 5 类任务，8 项报告指标；多数测试集 500 例，CVEFIX 240 例
task_type_en: Agent Task, Classification, Code Generation, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Public-dataset Integration, Fixed-seed Sampling, Modular Interactive Environments
intro_en: DefenderBench is a practical open-source toolkit for evaluating language agents' performance in offensive and defensive tasks and cybersecurity knowledge. It covers network intrusion, malicious content detection, code vulnerability analysis, and security knowledge assessment, supporting fair and rigorous testing of various mainstream large language models.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.00739, especially Sections 3-4, Figure 1, and Tables 1-2. DefenderBench converts public cybersecurity sources into five task types through download/cache, fixed-seed shuffle, filtering, and test/few-shot sampling. CyberBattleSim becomes a JSON/text game with Chain and CTF networks, three action types, and up to 100 steps. Malicious-text, malicious-web, CTI-MCQA, CodeXGLUE vulnerability, and Devign vulnerability evaluations use 500 test examples each with task-appropriate few-shot pools; CVEFix is filtered from 12,107 commits to 240 single-method, single-CVE samples across eight languages. Non-intrusion episodes allow up to five format-correcting steps. Task-native metrics are intrusion winning rate, macro-F1, and CodeBLEU; the global DefenderBench score is the unweighted average of eight reported task metrics, averaged over five runs.
